Title 17 – Copyrights.
§102: Subject matter of copyright – original works of authorship fixed in tangible medium (literary, musical, dramatic, pictorial, audiovisual, sound recordings, architectural).
§106: Exclusive rights – reproduce, prepare derivative works, distribute, perform, display.
§107: Fair use – purpose and character, nature of work, amount used, market effect.
§302: Duration – life of author + 70 years.
§501: Copyright infringement. §504: Remedies – statutory damages $750-$30,000 (up to $150,000 willful).
